characters.interactions_notes: He responds to the woman's prompts but rarely makes full eye contact with her, mostly answering while looking at his own phone or into middle distance. The power dynamic is mild and comedic: he holds the informational upper hand (explaining slang to her) but delivers it with the same exhausted affect as everything else in the scene, undercutting any authority. Turn-taking is quick and clipped, with minimal pauses, and neither character ever fully faces the other — their side-by-side, phone-in-hand staging visually reinforces the show's joke that these characters are perpetually 'low battery,' emotionally flat regardless of subject matter.
